content: Our model is greatly inspired by RAML, which gets samples from a non-parametric distribution INLINEFORM0 constructed based on a specific reward. Compared to RAML, our reward comes from a learnable discriminator which varies as the adversarial training proceeds rather than a specific reward function. This difference equips our framework with the ability to adapt to the text generation tasks with no explicit evaluation metrics as rewards.
